caption: The drawing features a single women’s shoe positioned in profile facing left, occupying the lower right portion of the image. The shoe is characterized by a pointed toe, a low heel, and a V-shaped vamp with a delicate looped bow detail. The shoe’s surface is decorated with a plaid or checked pattern consisting primarily of yellow, blue, and brown lines on a beige or light tan background. Above and to the left of the shoe, there are two faint pencil sketches depicting the shoe from a top view and a three-quarters top perspective, both with simple outlines and minimal detail. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Slipper
